name: read-aloud
description: A Chrome extension that reads aloud the webpage's content with just one click. Support 40+ languages. Fork adds Speechify-style hover sentence preview and click-to-seek playback.

scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd build/chrome && zip -r ../read-aloud-chrome.zip . -x *.map || true
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd build/firefox && zip -r ../read-aloud-firefox.zip . -x *.map || true
scripts.sync-page-scripts: rsync -avz js/messaging.js page-scripts/ && aws s3 sync --delete --metadata-directive REPLACE --cache-control max-age=14400,public page-scripts s3://lsdsoftware-assets/read-aloud/page-scripts

author: Hai Phan <hai.phan@gmail.com>
